procedure.hyperparameters: lightgbm/full selected configuration per horizon (training OOF), not re-tuned
procedure.folds: notebook-02 patient folds (5, stratified by source system and any creatinine AKI, seed of configs/ml.yaml)
procedure.rounds: minimum of the mean held-out log-loss curve over the 5 folds; final refit on all training patients
procedure.weights: inverse patient rows x balanced classes, as notebook 02
procedure.learned_preprocessing: fitted on the current training partition only (fold or full training set)

config.feature_source: stored notebook-01 snapshot features (legacy_prefix_v1, the engine the weights were trained on)
config.harness_check: reference_refit must reproduce the locked model's validation scores (max abs difference < 1e-5)

variants.name: reference_refit
variants.description: no change (checks that this procedure reproduces the locked model)

variants.name: windows_last_value_only
variants.description: drop every windowed vital-sign and laboratory summary (mean/min/max/std/slope/count)

variants.name: windows_short_only
variants.description: drop vital-sign and laboratory summaries over windows longer than 6 h (24 h and 48 h)

variants.name: windows_long_only
variants.description: drop the 6 h vital-sign summaries (keep 24 h vitals and 48 h laboratory summaries)

variants.name: missing_median_impute
variants.description: training-partition median imputation of every feature, no indicators

variants.name: missing_median_impute_indicators
variants.description: median imputation plus a missing indicator for each feature missing in >= 1% of training-partition rows

variants.name: missing_no_measurement_process
variants.description: drop measurement-process features (hours since latest value/charting, measurement counts)

specification.registration: immutable local record; not public preregistration
